covered_report_window.plain_language: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the Thursday, August 27, 2026 U.S. market close and before the Friday, August 28, 2026 U.S. market open

market_context_summary: July core PCE was 3.3% year over year, Treasury yields were elevated, and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Friday Jackson Hole remarks created macro and duration risk. Nvidia's strong AI demand read-through supported the semiconductor and AI-infrastructure narrative, but high expectations increased sell-the-news risk.

methodology.disparity_definition: 0-100 composite disagreement measure based on dispersion in direction scores and reversal-risk assessments across three independent passes; lower is tighter agreement

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Promotions, SG&A and softer forward comps
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Broad-based Q1 demand and shrink-driven gross-margin improvement create the cleanest positive setup, provided Q2 comps and the full-year margin outlook hold.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is about $6.19-$6.20 and revenue about $2.99 billion; options imply roughly a 9.1% move.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Transactions remain positive, comps exceed the full-year range, and gross margin stays firm.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A fine quarter could still sell off if promotions, investments or Target-partnership transition soften the outlook.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply approximately plus or minus 9.1%; a solid print must also support guidance.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Recent preview commentary is broadly constructive, but the key evidence is company-reported demand and margin momentum.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: ARR growth and forward revenue guide
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Buyback, cost discipline or low-bar relief
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Flat ARR and only 1% revenue growth leave little evidence of reacceleration under a new CEO, making forward ARR guidance the key downside risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $0.31 EPS and $123 million revenue after a prior-quarter EPS beat but weak growth.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Usage pricing, AI operations demand, buybacks and margin discipline create a relief rally.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: ARR remains flat or contracts and management guides to another low-growth quarter.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Reliable current implied-move data was unavailable; low share price and buyback support can amplify relief.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The prior quarter beat EPS, but the revenue outlook disappointed and ARR did not grow.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Conservative FY27 growth and credit tone
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Alternative data suggest GMV may clear the published bar, but the year-end reaction will depend more on fiscal 2027 growth and credit-quality guidance.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is roughly $0.33-$0.35 EPS and $1.11 billion revenue; company guidance was $13.15-$13.45 billion GMV and $1.08-$1.11 billion revenue.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: GMV growth approaches the low-30s, revenue less transaction costs stays firm, and FY27 starts near consensus.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Prime Day timing, spending softness or cautious credit/funding commentary lowers FY27 expectations.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply approximately plus or minus 10.7%, signaling a demanding event bar.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Published estimates point to about 26%-29% growth; Morgan Stanley cited data suggesting roughly 34% GMV growth but warned on FY27 guidance.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Current RPO and sales-led subscription growth
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Growth deceleration or soft FY27 guide
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strong RPO and sales-led subscription momentum support upside if Q1 validates Elastic's AI-platform consolidation story without sacrificing the FY27 margin path.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $0.58 EPS and $469.75 million revenue, nearly identical to company Q1 revenue guidance.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: cRPO remains near 20%, sales-led subscription beats, and FY27 guidance rises.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Reported revenue is in line while cRPO or the 19% full-year margin path softens.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Current reliable implied-move data was unavailable; software peers have punished in-line quarters with soft guidance.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The prior quarter beat key metrics and RPO grew 28%, while the Q1 revenue guide implied 13% growth.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Athleta weakness and tariff-sensitive margins offset Gap brand strength, leaving the stock vulnerable unless Old Navy and gross margin outperform.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is roughly $0.48-$0.49 EPS and $3.69-$3.74 billion revenue.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Old Navy and Gap comps beat, tariff relief is retained, and Athleta deterioration narrows.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Athleta remains deeply negative and promotions or sourcing costs pressure gross margin.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Reliable current implied-move data was unavailable; the prior report produced a sharp negative reaction despite an EPS beat.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q1 comps were positive for a ninth straight quarter and EPS guidance rose, but gross margin fell 130 basis points.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Q1 current RPO growth of 18% and a raised fiscal 2027 outlook favor another beat, but sales reorganization and acquisition uncertainty cap conviction.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $3.12 EPS and $2.01 billion revenue, inside company guidance of $2.005-$2.015 billion.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Current RPO and billings stay high teens and full-year revenue or FCF rises.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Sales reorganization disrupts bookings or MaintainX integration dilutes the guide.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply approximately plus or minus 8.1%.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Autodesk raised fiscal 2027 guidance after Q1 revenue grew 18% and current RPO grew 18%.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record net-new ARR and non-endpoint mix near half of ARR support upside, but the annual plan is back-end loaded and competition keeps reversal risk elevated.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $0.07 EPS and $290 million revenue; management has described a 45/55 first-half/second-half net-new ARR split.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: ARR growth accelerates, emerging solutions exceed half of ARR, and operating leverage improves.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: The second-half ramp slips or endpoint competition forces cautious guidance.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply approximately plus or minus 11.7%, the widest among the large covered names.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: SentinelOne beat EPS in the prior four quarters on average and recent analyst commentary has turned more constructive.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Subscription growth remains solid but is slowing, so a merely reiterated full-year guide may not offset concern about backlog deceleration.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $2.61 EPS and $2.64 billion revenue; Q1 subscription revenue grew 14.3% and 12-month backlog grew 15.5%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Backlog reaccelerates, AI wins improve tone, and the 30.5% margin guide rises.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Backlog growth slows further or fiscal 2027 subscription guidance is only maintained.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply approximately plus or minus 7.3%, with buybacks offering some downside support.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Management reiterated fiscal 2027 subscription revenue but raised margin guidance after Q1.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: AI demand is exceptional, but a roughly 180% year-to-date run makes the event require another material guide raise rather than an ordinary beat.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $0.93 EPS and $2.71-$2.72 billion revenue; Stifel expects Q3 revenue above its $3.0 billion estimate.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Custom silicon and optical demand drive Q3 above $3 billion and fiscal 2027/2028 targets rise again.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A beat without a large guide raise confirms growth but fails the buy-side bar.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply approximately plus or minus 10.4%-10.5%, close to the stock's long-run earnings move.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Analysts remain strongly constructive, but the estimate bar has risen with the stock.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Rubrik's operating momentum is excellent, but a near-50% one-month rally and prior selloff after a beat make the immediate setup vulnerable unless subscription ARR clears the whisper bar.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus revenue is about $396-$404 million, EPS about $0.04, and subscription ARR about $1.639 billion.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: ARR and net retention beat while FY27 ARR and FCF rise materially.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A normal beat or modest raise cannot justify the extended setup.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Dealer references place the event corridor around $100-$110; positioning is extended and neutral rather than clearly bullish.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Revisions and price targets have risen, including a Barclays target increase to $110.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: AI Cloud capacity and ARR delivery timeline
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Priced-in narrative and financing caution applied
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Contracted AI Cloud demand is powerful, but reported-quarter mining weakness, capital intensity and highly crowded expectations remove a clean event edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is roughly a $0.42 adjusted loss on $138.9 million revenue; management targets more than $4 billion annualized AI Cloud revenue by year-end 2026.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Horizon deployments stay on schedule, capacity is funded, and new contracts validate the ARR ladder.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Delivery timing slips, cash needs rise, or dilution dominates the long-dated contract story.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply approximately plus or minus 10.9%; retail sentiment is intensely bullish and concentrated.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Analyst targets are constructive, but current-quarter estimates remain weak because contracted AI capacity is not yet fully online.
